sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Elektronik's key (Elektronik) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A standard key, distinguished only by a Mechanic keychain. Seems Elektronik has a sense of humor. And a Tarko figurine supply channel.

sections.text: Door to apartment 2 on the first floor of the Klimova 14A building at Streets of Tarkov. The entrance is on the backyard side.
